name: Abtech ZAG enclosure
summary: Aluminium junction-box family for industrial cable and instrumentation layouts.
description: The ZAG family uses cast metal bodies with removable covers. An equipment layout must coordinate tapped entries, internal terminal positions and enclosure mounting.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: Show the machined entry face and thread specification in the manufacturing detail rather than assuming the stock CAD contains project drilling.
A standard unmachined model does not describe a customised junction-box assembly.
drawingChecklist: Select the exact ZAG size and finish.
Coordinate gland threads with wall thickness and internal obstacles.
Reserve cover fastener access and identify earthing connections.
distinction: A standard unmachined model does not describe a customised junction-box assembly.
